//: AgentTokens: agents authenticate with OIDC access tokens (Entra-first, ADR-0004). CredProx CallerToken keys: Authority = the OIDC issuer whose published metadata validates tokens; Audience = a token minted for any other API is refused; MaxTokenAge = d.HH:mm:ss cap measured from iat. Callers: one entry per agent application; TokenClientIds = the app (client) ids whose tokens (azp claim) map to that caller, verbatim; Operations = NAMED rules — a token is admitted only where its roles claim names the rule, so scopes narrow and never widen. Destinations: where the credential attaches — this sample forwards the agent's own request untouched. The values below are the real shape — replace the three YOUR-* placeholders and it runs against Entra. The offline demo (docker compose + ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT=Development, see README) repoints the issuer, audience, client id and destination at the local WireMock stubs through appsettings.Development.json.
